neighbours.label: a group or population noun that is not sex-specific (teens, species, Americans), the other side of the + pole's men/women/boys/girls
fire: The survey found that teens who sleep less tend to report lower grades.
In the study, adults over sixty walked more slowly than expected.
According to the report, residents of the coastal towns pay higher insurance.
Researchers noted that children in rural areas start school a year later.
The new rules affect patients who have waited more than six months.
Doctors say that adolescents with asthma should carry an inhaler.
The census showed that voters in the suburbs shifted toward the center.
Biologists counted how many species of frog still live in the valley.
quiet: The survey found that girls who sleep less tend to report lower grades.
In the study, men over sixty walked more slowly than expected.
According to the report, women in the coastal towns pay higher insurance.
Researchers noted that boys in rural areas start school a year later.
The new rules affect mothers who have waited more than six months.
Doctors say that males with asthma should carry an inhaler more often.
The census showed that husbands in the suburbs shifted toward the center.
Biologists counted how many female frogs still live in the valley.

notes: Card: + pole is clearly sex-specific group nouns (males, women, girls); - top examples are mixed (average, America, subspecies, teens, browser). Tested the guess that the - pole is the non-gendered side of the same group-noun slot; near misses use the same frames with men/women.
